brief:
Israeli soldiers destroyed a memorial at Birzeit University dedicated to students and alumni killed by Israel, Al Jazeera English reported. The soldiers removed the monument and replaced it with a fig sapling.

The destruction targeted a structure commemorating Palestinians who died in connection with Israeli military operations. University officials characterized the action as an attempt to erase Palestinian historical memory.
dek: Israeli soldiers removed the monument to students and alumni killed by Israel and replaced it with a fig sapling.
title: Israeli soldiers remove Birzeit memorial, plant fig sapling in its place
